notes: Every observed output is exactly the input with each character's ASCII code increased by 1 — letters, digits, spaces, and punctuation all shift uniformly (e.g. `"abc123"→"Bcd234"`, `"Hello World function lazy"→"Ifmmp!xpsme!gvodujpo!mb{z"`, space→`!`, `z`→`{`). So the box is a simple Caesar shift of +1 over the full character set.
